Definition: Debir, the name of an Amoritish king and of two places in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Debir = "sanctuary"; n pr m; 1) the king of Eglon, one of the five kings hanged by Joshua; n pr loc; 2) a town in the mountains of Judah west of Hebron and given to the priests and a city of refuge; 3) a place on the northern boundary of Judah; 4) a town in the territory of Gad
